premises.text: Most household bikes sit unused while shop and bike-share rentals are expensive for leisure rides
premises.evidence_span: about 70% of US households actually have a bicycle, but only 0.6% of them are used daily

premises.text: SpinLister is an infrastructure-light peer marketplace that lists owner bikes for travelers and locals at owner-set prices
premises.evidence_span: looking to do that with SpinLister in a location-independent way that is extremely infrastructure-light

premises.text: Platform reviews listings, shows nearest bikes, and facilitates insured owner-renter handoffs with messaging
premises.evidence_span: We review each listing to make sure that it looks good and is a compelling offering for our marketplace

premises.text: Bikes are insured up to $5,000 with institutional backup coverage
premises.evidence_span: We insure bicycles up to $5,000. And we have institutional insurance, as well

value.text: Connect travelers and locals to individual bike owners for exploration rides
value.evidence_span: allow individual bike owners to rent out their bikes to travelers and locals looking to explore

secondary_value.text: Owners deliver personalized local tips and flexible pickup as part of the rental experience
secondary_value.evidence_span: allow this lister to really own the customer service experience
